title_sq: VILE PER SHITJE TE REZIDENCA LULEBORE!
description_sq:
VILE PER SHITJE TE REZIDENCA LULEBORE!
Kompleksi eshte ne faze ndertimi dhe pritet te perfundoje ne maj te vitit 2025.
Ka nje cilesi te larte ndertimi dhe do ofroje nje stil jetese luksoz.
Eshte i ndare ne tre kate, ku ne katin perdhe eshte hapesira e garazhdit per dy automjete, nje dhome ndenje, nje tualet, lavanteria dhe depo
Kati i pare eshte i organizuar ne nje koridor hyres, nje studio, nje tualet, nje depo dhe kuzhine e vecuar.
Kati i dyte eshte i organizuar ne tre dhoma gjumi, dy tualete, nje garderobe dhe dy ballkone
Vila ka hapesire oborri te bollshme dhe me nje hapesire per pishine ne baze te preferences.
Per me shume informacion apo nje vizite ne prone mos nguroni te kontaktoni!
title_en: VILLA FOR SALE IN LULEBORE RESIDENCE!
description_en: VILLA FOR SALE IN LULEBORE RESIDENCE! The complex is under construction and is expected to be completed in May 2025. It has a high quality of construction and will offer a luxurious lifestyle. It is divided into three floors, where on the ground floor there is a garage for two vehicles, a living room, a toilet, a laundry room and a storage room. The first floor is organized into an entrance corridor, a studio, a toilet, a storage room and a separate kitchen. The second floor is organized into three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a wardrobe and two balconies. The villa has ample yard space and a pool space based on preference. For more information or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us!
